definitions.explanation: Something wrapped up, typically in paper or cloth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧{包|つつ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}った→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
{包|つつ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けて→開ける：00563_akeru⟧⟦みた→みる：00283_miru⟧。

notes:
{包|つつ}み is a noun derived from the verb ⟦{包|つつ}む→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧ (to wrap). It refers to something wrapped up, typically in paper, cloth, or wrapping material.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {包|つつ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open a package
- {包|つつ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to receive a package
- ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{包|つつ}み: paper-wrapped package

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{小包|こづつみ}→小包：02764_kozutsumi⟧: parcel, small package (postal term)
- ⟦{風呂敷|ふろしき}→風呂敷：05798_furoshiki⟧{包|づつ}み: bundle wrapped in furoshiki cloth

REGISTER:
{包|つつ}み has a traditional, slightly literary feel. In modern everyday speech, ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧ (luggage, package) or パッケージ is more common for general packages. {包|つつ}み evokes something carefully wrapped, often by hand.
